Visitor replaces form with custom output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitForm(NodeContext ctx, String action, String method) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom("[FORM PLACEHOLDER]");
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<div><form action=\"/submit\" method=\"POST\"><label>Name: <input type=\"text\" name=\"name\"></label><button type=\"submit\">Submit</button></form></div>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
